lines.text: And I'm Mishu! Today let's count from one to ten!
Now let's count some yummy fruits!
Let's go to the farm and count the animals!
Beep, beep! Let's count the vehicles!
Big kids, this one is for you! Let's add!
Let's say a counting rhyme together!
Once I caught a fish alive!
Then I let it go again!
Once I caught a fish alive!
Then I let it go again!
Why did you let it go?
Because it bit my finger so!
Now let's count backwards! Ten to one!
We counted so many things today!
What is your favourite number? Mine is five!
